summary: Furnace minecarts lose power after navigating corners
description:
## The bug

Furnace Minecarts lose power after navigating corners.

## How to reproduce

 - In creative mode, create a long straight section of track, with a shorter section at one end creating an L-shape

 - Place a furnace minecart on the shorter section just before the corner

 - Right click on the powered minecart with charcoal, while looking forwards but against the curve

→ After rounding the corner, the furnace minecart will roll to a stop 10 blocks along the track as though it was unpowered

## Proposed fix

Provided by thinkofdeath in the comments: https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-51053?focusedCommentId=223854&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels:comment-tabpanel#comment-223854

## Workaround

If the minecart is right-clicked again after it has stopped while you are facing in the correct direction, it will start moving again. Additional fuel doesn't need to be provided – just clicking it fixes the direction and will cause the old fuel to be used properly.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create or enter a Creative world.
2. Create a long straight section of track with a shorter section at one end, forming an L-shape.
3. Place a furnace minecart on the shorter section just before the corner.
4. Face forwards while looking against the curve.
5. Right-click the furnace minecart with charcoal.
6. Wait until the furnace minecart rounds the corner.
7. Observe that the furnace minecart rolls to a stop 10 blocks along the track as though it were unpowered.
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

When a furnace minecart is fueled while approaching an L-shaped corner, it initially moves as expected. After navigating the curved rail, however, it stops accelerating and coasts to a stop approximately 10 blocks farther along the straight track, even though the furnace minecart still has unused fuel.

The minecart behaves as though it is no longer powered after changing direction around the corner. Right-clicking the stopped minecart while facing along the correct direction immediately makes it move again and allows it to use the remaining fuel; no additional fuel is required.
Expected Behavior: After rounding the corner, the furnace minecart should retain the power provided by the charcoal and continue traveling along the track at its expected speed. Navigating the curve should not cause it to behave as though it is unpowered or stop prematurely. The minecart should keep moving without requiring another interaction or additional fuel.
